eligibility: World is active in ROLL, with no prior head support from roll entry through the intervention boundary. No selection by outcome. Worlds that are ineligible stay in the original denominator, and support coverage is reported.
injection: At the verified fork and before the next physical substep, add one horizontal translational velocity delta along the world lateral axis defined by each world's heading at standing departure. Preserve vertical, angular and joint velocities, orientation, stored sensor data and delayed actuator histories. Record a zero-push reference and both signs with the same pre-push states.
scoring: Keep the entire original roll revolution, head penetration and contact, landing dwell, stand and 20-second forward criteria. Preserve at least 116/128 complete and 116/128 roll successes per arm. Apply the original impossible-budget stop and report where any paired losses first occur.
